wikimediacustomizations-restsandbox-text: Isticmaal boggan si aad ugu tijaabiso MediaWiki REST APIs. Wicitaannada API-ga ee lagu sameeyo is dhexgalka tijaabada waxay la falgeli doonaan nuxurka wiki-ga tooska ah, waxaana laga yaabaa inay wax ka beddelaan wiki-ga. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan isticmaalka API-ga, eeg [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/API:REST_API dukumentiyada API-ga].
wikimediacustomizations-restsandbox-disc:
Ma haysaa faallooyin ku saabsan goobtan tijaabada? Fadlan ku reeb [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/MediaWiki_Interfaces_Team/Feature_Feedback/REST_Sandbox halkan].
Fiiro gaar ah: is-dhexgalka isticmaalaha iyo walxaha hagidda ee goobta tijaabada weli ma taageeraan turjumaadda.
wikimediacustomizations-restsandbox-sele: Dooro API-ga aad rabto inaad sahamiso.
wikimediacustomizations-restsandbox-no-s: Ma jiraan REST APIs loo habeeyay sahaminta. Isticmaal dejinta RestSandboxSpecs.
Xuduudda API-ga ee la bixiyay lama taageero: $1
wikimediacustomizations-restsandbox-json: JavaScript ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo arko qeexitaanka REST.
